title: CI FR8447 skill assertion is stale after body-pin removal
body: what: test_fr8447_bobiverse_pin_is_label_or_body_line expects require_machine: ionos in a skill that no longer documents body-only pinning. where: jeeves/tests/test_fr8447_monitor_pin_bullet.py:18 and jeeves/.grok/skills/bobiverse-jeeves-monitor/SKILL.md. evidence: build-jeeves fails this assertion on PR #9681; the same test fails on base SHA 18738ede, whose skill text omits the phrase consistently with FR #9637. fix: update the stale assertion to pin the current label/body-note policy.
